svg.desc: Rehabilitation and Construction of Factories in Menya LOCATION Menya, Egypt CLIENT Cotton & Textile Industries Holding Co. COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2024 500 million EGP DISCIPLINES Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview The rehabilitation and construction of Upper Egypt for Spinning and Weaving Co. factories in Menya governorate. BECT's scope included detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management. The multidisciplinary services covered architectural design, structural / civil engineering, mechanical engineering and electrical engineering.

g.text: Upper Egypt for Spinning and Weaving
